_readme: Edit this file to update the portfolio. Each project needs a unique `id` (used in the URL: project.html?id=<id>). `type` must be one of the keys in `types`. `status` must be one of the keys in `statuses`. `featured: true` puts the project in the spotlight row on the home page. Projects appear in the order listed here. Screenshot and icon paths are relative to the site root. Set `orientation` to `portrait` (phone shots) or `landscape` (PC / browser / tablet shots). Leave `icon` empty to use `fallbackIcon` (any Lucide icon name).

projects.name: CatAsTrophe – Feline Rescue
projects.tagline: Sneak past 20 kinds of patrolling animals and lead every lost kitten to the rescue van.
projects.summary: A stealth-rescue game with 4 worlds, 32 hand-built stages, 14 heroes with unique abilities, endless arenas and a full live-ops loop. It's on Google Play and the Microsoft Store.
description: The kittens are lost, and the neighbourhood animals are on patrol. Players ping a sonar radar to find kittens hiding in bushes, barrels and boxes, hold to rescue them, then lead the whole paw-parade back to the van without getting caught.

Each of the 20 animals has its own behaviour to learn: dogs prowl, rhinos charge, parrots swoop and crocodiles lie in wait. Four themed worlds add traps, crumbling bridges, keys and gates, teleporters and sandstorms.
We built and shipped it on two storefronts from a single Unity 6 codebase, with separate store flavours for Google Play and the Microsoft Store (GDK), each with its own billing and achievements.

highlights.title: 4 worlds, 32 stages
highlights.text: Suburb Chaos, Frozen Peaks, Desert Disaster and Mars Meltdown, with up to three stars per stage and endless arenas.

highlights.title: 14 heroes, 6 abilities
highlights.text: Radar pulse, sprint, shield bubble, catnip decoy, stealth cloak and stun whistle. Heroes level up with shards from chests.

highlights.title: 20 animal AIs
highlights.text: Each patrol animal has distinct sight, movement and chase behaviour, so players have to learn every one of them.

highlights.title: Live-ops loop
highlights.text: 7-day login calendar, daily and weekly missions, daily shop deals and a collectible kitten album with rare golden kittens.

highlights.title: Play Games Services
highlights.text: Achievements, leaderboards and cloud save across devices through Google Play Games.

highlights.title: Multi-store billing
highlights.text: One codebase that maps products to Google Play and Microsoft Store add-on IDs, with remove-ads, gem packs and a starter pack.

projects.name: Estimates & Invoices – Quote it
projects.tagline: Win the job before you leave the driveway: signed PDF quotes in about a minute, even offline.
projects.summary: An offline-first estimate and invoice maker for contractors and tradespeople, with branded PDFs, e-signatures, payment tracking and a revenue dashboard.
description: Quote it lets contractors walk the job, tap in the work, capture the client's signature and send a clean, professional PDF quote on the spot, with zero signal if needed.

Approved estimates convert to invoices with one tap. Full or partial payments, overdue invoices and polite payment reminders are all handled from the phone, and a dashboard shows money pending, paid and overdue alongside monthly revenue and estimate win rate.
Under the hood it uses a local SQLite database as the source of truth, syncs to Firebase in the background, and renders PDFs from five designed templates.

highlights.title: Offline-first
highlights.text: SQLite on the device is the source of truth. Quotes work on a rooftop with no signal and sync later.

highlights.title: Signature capture
highlights.text: Clients sign right on the phone, and the signature is embedded in the final PDF.

highlights.title: 5 PDF designs
highlights.text: Classic, Modern Slate, Warm Terracotta, Emerald Contractor and Minimal Mono, with business branding and payment terms.

highlights.title: Get paid faster
highlights.text: Estimate-to-invoice in one tap, partial payments, balance due, overdue flags and one-tap reminders.

highlights.title: Know your numbers
highlights.text: Dashboard with pending, paid and overdue totals, a monthly revenue chart and estimate win rate.

highlights.title: Share anywhere
highlights.text: Send by WhatsApp, email or SMS, or print directly from the phone.

projects.name: Swipe Dash
projects.tagline: A neon three-lane runner with real-time online races for up to 4 players.
projects.summary: A fast arcade runner with real-time multiplayer (Unity Lobby + Relay), accounts with cross-device cloud save, and 12 unlockable characters. Live on the Microsoft Store.
description: Swipe Dash is easy to pick up and hard to put down. Players switch lanes to dodge barriers, steer around rocks and collect glowing coins while the track speeds up every 15 seconds.

RACE ONLINE puts up to four players on the same track in real time. Quick Race finds a match in seconds, or players can create a private race and share a join code with friends. Every racer is shown in their own colour, with name tags, flags and trails.
Progress works as a guest with no sign-up, and a free account adds Firestore cloud save with a three-way merge across PC and phone.

highlights.title: 4-player online races
highlights.text: Real-time races built on Netcode for GameObjects with Unity Lobby and Relay, with quick match or private join codes.

highlights.title: Cross-device cloud save
highlights.text: Guest-first accounts with Firebase Auth and a batched, offline-safe Firestore sync that merges progress across devices.

highlights.title: 12 characters, trails and coins
highlights.text: Unlockable characters that blink and react, coin shapes, neon trails, and about 230 searchable country flags.

highlights.title: Play your way
highlights.text: Swipe on mobile, or use keyboard, mouse drag or a gamepad on PC.

highlights.title: Tested and secured
highlights.text: EditMode and PlayMode test suites, plus versioned Firestore security rules with emulator tests.

highlights.title: Cross-platform
highlights.text: One Unity 6 codebase ships an ad-free Windows build to the Microsoft Store and an Android build.

projects.name: Metro Live Dhaka
projects.tagline: Watch Dhaka MRT Line 6 trains move through a low-poly 3D city in real time.
projects.summary: A real-time transit visualiser for Dhaka Metro Rail with fares, schedules, live 3D trains from four camera angles, GPS ride-along and a commuter passport.
description: Metro Live Dhaka gives commuters fares and schedules for MRT Line 6, then goes further: trains move through a low-poly Dhaka rendered in 3D, viewable from chase, cab, platform and overview cameras.
With GPS ride-along the app follows the rider's own train. A commuter passport collects stamps for stations visited, and Rapid Pass top-ups open the official site without leaving the app.
All transit logic runs on the device. The only network use is an optional Firebase backup of the passport, and the app is fully localised in Bangla and English.

highlights.title: Real-time 3D city
highlights.text: Three.js on expo-gl renders a low-poly Dhaka with trains moving on the live timetable.

highlights.title: 4 camera angles
highlights.text: Chase, cab, platform and overview cameras, with day, golden-hour and night lighting.

highlights.title: GPS ride-along
highlights.text: Background location follows the rider's train and counts down to the next station.

highlights.title: Commuter passport
highlights.text: Collect stamps for every station visited, with an optional cloud backup.

highlights.title: Bangla + English
highlights.text: Fully localised UI and store listing for both languages.

highlights.title: On-device logic
highlights.text: Fares, schedules and train positions are computed locally, with no backend needed.

projects.name: Noor: Prayer Times & Quran
projects.tagline: Accurate prayer times, the full Quran with audio, and a Qibla compass in one calm app.
projects.summary: A Muslim lifestyle app with GPS prayer times, athan notifications, all 114 surahs with recitation, a Qibla compass, tasbeeh and habit streaks.
description: Noor gives accurate Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha times for the user's exact location, with a live countdown, athan notifications and five trusted calculation methods.
The full Holy Quran is included in Uthmani script with Sahih International translation and ayah-by-ayah recitation by Sheikh Mishary Rashid Alafasy.
Streaks, daily goals and badges turn salah, Quran and dhikr into a lasting habit.

highlights.title: Accurate prayer times
highlights.text: GPS or any city, 5 calculation methods (ISNA, MWL, Umm al-Qura, Egyptian, UOIF), plus a monthly timetable that works offline.

highlights.title: Athan reminders
highlights.text: Scheduled athan notifications for every salah, with a gentle pre-prayer reminder.

highlights.title: Quran with audio
highlights.text: All 114 surahs with translation and ayah-by-ayah audio recitation.

highlights.title: Qibla compass
highlights.text: Live compass needle with exact bearing and calibration guidance.

highlights.title: Habit streaks
highlights.text: Streaks, daily goals and badges across salah, Quran and dhikr.

highlights.title: Production monitoring
highlights.text: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sentry keep the release stable.

projects.name: Crazy Car: Endless Car Racing
projects.tagline: Weave through traffic, hit nitro and chase a new best on four wild roads.
projects.summary: An endless highway racer with 25 upgradeable cars, 4 themed roads, near-miss scoring, power-ups and tilt or wheel steering.
description: Crazy Car is an endless racer where the road gets faster and busier the longer you survive. Skimming past cars pays out near-miss bonus coins, and NITRO blasts you past the pack.

Players unlock 25 cars, from a City Sedan up to the Future GT, and upgrade five stats on each. Four roads, Countryside, Fantasy Town, Graveyard and Pirate Coast, raise the risk and the coin multiplier.

highlights.title: 25 cars, 5 upgrade stats
highlights.text: Speed, acceleration, handling, armor and nitro on every car.

highlights.title: 4 themed roads
highlights.text: Riskier roads pay more, with up to +35% coins on Pirate Coast.

highlights.title: Near-miss scoring
highlights.text: The closer you skim traffic, the more you earn.

highlights.title: Wheel or tilt
highlights.text: On-screen steering wheel or gyroscope tilt, with large gas and brake buttons.

highlights.title: Power-ups
highlights.text: Shield, coin magnet and nitro refills on the road.

projects.name: School College List BD: EIIN
projects.tagline: Search 34,901 schools, colleges and madrasas across all 64 districts, even offline.
projects.summary: An offline directory of every educational institute in Bangladesh with instant search, Division → District → Thana filters, EIIN/MPO details and bookmarks.
description: No more scrolling through PDFs and outdated websites. The app holds 34,901 educational institutes from all 64 districts of Bangladesh, searchable as you type, with no internet needed.

Students choosing an HSC college, parents looking for a school near home, and teachers or job seekers checking an EIIN or MPO status can filter by division, district, thana, institute type, management, level and affiliation.

highlights.title: 34,901 institutes on-device
highlights.text: A bundled SQLite database gives instant, fully offline search.

highlights.title: Deep filters
highlights.text: Division → District → Thana, plus type, management, education level and affiliation.

highlights.title: Bookmarks & profiles
highlights.text: Save institutes and see full details including EIIN and MPO status.

highlights.title: Bangla & English
highlights.text: Complete bilingual UI with light and dark themes.

projects.name: GuardRail AI – Privacy Shield for AI Chats
projects.tagline: Stop sensitive data leaking into ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, detected on-device.
projects.summary: A data-loss-prevention layer for AI chats. It scans prompts for PII, secrets and company red-flag keywords before they're sent, with an IT-manager console and incident audit trail.
description: GuardRail AI sits between a team and AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and keeps trade secrets, credentials and personal data from leaving the browser.

Prompts are scanned in real time against keyword lists and regex patterns (API keys, internal IDs, card numbers). Violations are blurred and blocked before submission, and IT managers push rules to every employee and review an audit trail of blocked attempts.

highlights.title: On-device detection
highlights.text: Real-time scanning of AI prompt inputs. Nothing is sent to a server to be checked.

highlights.title: Instant intervention
highlights.text: Blurs and blocks submission when a violation is detected, with smart redaction.

highlights.title: IT manager console
highlights.text: Centrally defined red-flag keywords and regex rules, pushed to every seat in real time.

highlights.title: Audit trail
highlights.text: A log of every blocked attempt with user, site and the specific violation.

highlights.title: Multi-tenant
highlights.text: Company data is isolated with Firebase security rules.

projects.name: Minimalist Expense Tracker
projects.tagline: Log a purchase in 3 seconds and turn saving money into a game.
projects.summary: A budgeting app built around 1-tap logging, gamified streaks and leaderboards, clean insights, and Pro exports to Excel and PDF.
description: Minimalist Expense Tracker strips away confusing charts and banking jargon. Open the app, tap a category, and you're done. Logging takes about three seconds.

Badges, streaks, levels and a global top-100 leaderboard reward staying on budget. Pro unlocks full history, Excel and PDF export, custom ranges, budget alerts and period-over-period comparisons through a RevenueCat subscription.

highlights.title: 1-tap logging
highlights.text: No forms or typing. Each expense takes about three seconds.

highlights.title: Gamified budgeting
highlights.text: Badges, daily streaks, levels and a global leaderboard of top savers.

highlights.title: Real insights
highlights.text: Weekly, monthly and yearly charts with a smart daily budget tip.

highlights.title: Excel & PDF export
highlights.text: Pro reports export to XLSX or PDF for any date range.

highlights.title: Subscriptions
highlights.text: Pro tier powered by RevenueCat.

projects.name: Sea Blaster: Pirate Ships
projects.tagline: Steer one-handed, auto-blast pirate fleets, dodge cannon fire and upgrade your ship.
projects.summary: A colourful arcade shooter with auto-firing cannons, 7 collectible pirate ships, boss fights, telegraphed enemy fire and Play Games achievements.
description: Players race down an endless sea, sink pirate fleets and grow stronger every run. The cannon locks on and fires by itself, so the whole game is about steering, positioning and staying alive.
Enemy ships and sea towers fire back, and a red marker shows where each shot will land. Seven ships to unlock, from fast smugglers to the cursed Ghost Ship, each play differently.

highlights.title: Auto-fire combat
highlights.text: One-finger steering while the cannon targets enemies automatically.

highlights.title: 7 pirate ships
highlights.text: Smugglers, brigantines, ironclads, the triple-shot galleon and the Ghost Ship.

highlights.title: Boss battles
highlights.text: Telegraphed attacks and multi-stage bosses across five seas.

highlights.title: 30 achievements
highlights.text: Google Play Games achievements and leaderboards for best stage and ships sunk.

highlights.title: Daily rewards
highlights.text: Login rewards, three daily missions and a weekly challenge.

projects.name: Brew Buddy: Sleep Cycle Repair
projects.tagline: A caffeine tracker that models decay in real time, so coffee stops stealing your sleep.
projects.summary: A caffeine tracker that uses a half-life decay model to show how much caffeine is active right now and at bedtime, with sleep-aware cutoff alerts.
description: Brew Buddy doesn't just count cups. A caffeine half-life model gives a live estimate of the milligrams still active, updating as time passes and tuned to slow, average or fast metabolism.
Users set a bedtime and a sleep-safe threshold, and the app predicts caffeine at lights-out and warns before a cup would still be active when they turn in.

highlights.title: Live decay model
highlights.text: Half-life pharmacokinetics give a real-time estimate of active caffeine.

highlights.title: Sleep-aware alerts
highlights.text: Predicts the level at bedtime and warns before a late cup.

highlights.title: Custom drink library
highlights.text: Espresso, cold brew, tea and energy drinks, plus custom presets and cup sizes.

highlights.title: Analytics
highlights.text: Rich charts rendered with Skia and Gifted Charts.

projects.name: Promptly – AI Prompt Management Suite
projects.tagline: A prompt library and memory layer for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
projects.summary: A prompt manager with variable templates, a New Tab workspace, an in-chat sidebar for one-click injection, cloud sync and team seats.
description: Promptly sits between the user and AI models as a memory layer for complex, repetitive instructions. Templates use [Variable] placeholders that are detected automatically and filled in at use time.

A New Tab workspace organises prompts into workflows, and a sidebar inside ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini injects them with one click. Prompts sync through Firebase, and Pro and Team tiers are billed through Lemon Squeezy.

highlights.title: Variable templates
highlights.text: [Tone], [Subject] and similar placeholders are detected and filled at run time.

highlights.title: In-chat sidebar
highlights.text: One-click prompt injection inside ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

highlights.title: New Tab workspace
highlights.text: Drag-and-drop boards to organise prompts into workflows.

highlights.title: Cloud sync & teams
highlights.text: Firebase sync with local-first caching, plus shared team workflows.

highlights.title: SaaS billing
highlights.text: Pro status verified in real time through the Lemon Squeezy API.

projects.name: Tazkiyah – Habit Builder
projects.tagline: A free, ad-free Islamic habit builder with Quran, prayer times, Qibla and Ramadan mode.
projects.summary: A local-first habit app for prayers, Quran and Sunnah, with forgiving streaks, tiered achievements, activity heatmaps and a Hijri-calendar Ramadan mode, built to run at zero backend cost.
description: Tazkiyah works fully offline from first launch on an anonymous account. Signing in only adds cross-device sync and the leaderboard.

Users track the five daily prayers, Jummah and Ramadan habits alongside unlimited custom ones, with grace-day streaks that aren't all-or-nothing. Prayer times come from the Aladhan API, the Quran from Al-Quran Cloud (cached offline), and the Qibla from the device magnetometer.

highlights.title: Forgiving streaks
highlights.text: Grace-day logic keeps one missed day from wiping out progress.

highlights.title: Tiered achievements
highlights.text: Common-to-legendary badges that unlock cosmetic profile rings.

highlights.title: Activity heatmap
highlights.text: GitHub-style heatmap and per-habit consistency stats.

highlights.title: Ramadan mode
highlights.text: Real Hijri-calendar detection, a 30-day dua library and daily challenges.

highlights.title: Qibla compass
highlights.text: Magnetometer and great-circle bearing to the Kaaba, with distance.

highlights.title: Zero backend cost
highlights.text: Local-first design with a minimal Firebase footprint, so it can scale for free.

projects.name: Meeting Cost Calculator
projects.tagline: See what every Google Meet, Zoom and Teams call really costs, live.
projects.summary: A real-time meeting cost overlay for Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams, with ROI tracking, a dashboard and PDF and Excel reports. No access to audio, video or chat.
description: Meeting Cost Calculator adds a live cost ticker to video calls based on participant count and hourly rates, and updates as people join or leave.
A dashboard flags expensive recurring meetings and exports reports to PDF or Excel. All calculations run locally, and the extension never reads meeting audio, video or chat.

highlights.title: Live cost overlay
highlights.text: A draggable ticker inside Meet, Zoom and Teams.

highlights.title: ROI insights
highlights.text: Spots low-value and expensive recurring meetings.

highlights.title: PDF & Excel reports
highlights.text: Exports with jsPDF and SheetJS.

highlights.title: Privacy-first
highlights.text: Local calculations only, with no meeting content accessed.

projects.name: Time Travel Taxi: Car Racing
projects.tagline: Pick up fares across time, drift through portals and beat the clock.
projects.summary: An arcade taxi racer across Modern, Fantasy and Haunted eras, with drift physics, time portals, passenger events and an upgradeable garage of time-machine taxis.
description: Every fare is a race. Players find the passenger, pick them up and deliver before time runs out, grabbing glowing time potions for extra seconds and chaining deliveries for tips.
Time portals jump between a busy modern city, an enchanted fantasy kingdom and a haunted graveyard mid-run, and drift mechanics let the taxi slide around corners without losing speed.

highlights.title: Beat the clock
highlights.text: Fare timers, time potions and delivery chains for tips.

highlights.title: 3 eras via portals
highlights.text: Modern City, Fantasy Kingdom and Haunted Graveyard, switched mid-run.

highlights.title: Drift physics
highlights.text: Slide around corners and off walls without losing speed, with nitro boost.

highlights.title: Upgradeable garage
highlights.text: A collection of time-machine taxis with upgrades and customisation.

projects.name: Lockfy: Lockscreen & Wallpaper
projects.tagline: Design a lock screen wallpaper with emergency and medical info built right in.
projects.summary: A paid lock screen editor with templates, photo, gradient and text layers, safety stickers and full-resolution export. ICE contacts stay readable without unlocking the phone.
description: Lockfy puts a full layered editor in your pocket. Users start from a template or a blank canvas, add photos, gradients, text and stickers, and arrange everything with gestures.
A lock screen guide shows where the clock and widgets sit so nothing important gets hidden, and the result exports at full resolution and sets as the wallpaper in one step.

highlights.title: Layered canvas editor
highlights.text: Move, scale, rotate and layer elements with multi-touch gestures, plus undo/redo and autosave.

highlights.title: ICE & medical info
highlights.text: Emergency contacts, blood type and allergies, readable from the lock screen.

highlights.title: Rich typography
highlights.text: Curated fonts, colours, alignment and shadows.

highlights.title: Full-res export
highlights.text: Renders the canvas at device resolution and sets it directly.

projects.name: DealMagnet: The Intelligence Layer
projects.tagline: A lightweight deal pipeline inside Gmail and LinkedIn.
projects.summary: A sales intelligence extension that captures leads from Gmail and LinkedIn profiles into a staged pipeline board, with cloud sync and Pro licensing.
description: DealMagnet adds deal intelligence to the tools salespeople already live in. It captures a profile's headline and role from LinkedIn or a contact from Gmail in one click, so every lead already has context.
Captured leads flow into a pipeline board with Lead, Contacted, Negotiation and Closed stages, synced with Firebase and unlocked for Pro through Lemon Squeezy.

highlights.title: Gmail & LinkedIn
highlights.text: Content scripts surface a deal panel next to the conversation or profile.

highlights.title: Pipeline board
highlights.text: Every deal touched, organised by stage.

highlights.title: Cloud sync
highlights.text: Firebase-backed so the pipeline follows the user.

highlights.title: Pro licensing
highlights.text: Lemon Squeezy subscriptions.

projects.name: SwiftServe
projects.tagline: White-label restaurant management: QR ordering, POS, kitchen display and admin in one platform.
projects.summary: A multi-tenant restaurant SaaS with subdomain-per-restaurant routing, real-time order flow over WebSockets, four React apps (admin, POS, KDS, customer QR ordering) and subscription billing.
description: SwiftServe is built for small restaurants that need to cut manpower without losing speed. Customers order from a QR-code PWA at the table, orders stream live to a kitchen display, and waitstaff and cashiers run a PWA point of sale.

Each restaurant gets its own subdomain, resolved from the Host header on every request, and every tenant-owned document is scoped by restaurantId through a global enforcement layer with isolation tests. Prices and tax are always computed server-side.

highlights.title: QR table ordering
highlights.text: A customer PWA that orders straight from the table.

highlights.title: Kitchen display
highlights.text: Live order lifecycle from Pending to Received, Preparing, Ready, Served and Paid over Socket.IO.

highlights.title: PWA point of sale
highlights.text: For waitstaff and cashiers, with Cash, Card, bKash and Nagad payment recording.

highlights.title: Subdomain multi-tenancy
highlights.text: <slug>.swiftserve.app with strict per-tenant data isolation.

highlights.title: Subscription billing
highlights.text: Plans and invoices behind a provider interface ready for automated collection.

highlights.title: Docker deploy
highlights.text: API, MongoDB and Nginx on Docker Compose with wildcard TLS.

projects.name: GenZym – Digital Gym
projects.tagline: Tiny daily challenges, real XP, zero guilt. A gym that doesn't take itself seriously.
projects.summary: A gamified micro-fitness app with random daily routines, XP, coins, streaks, a cosmetic store and leaderboards, with Gen-Z humour and a dark-only design.
description: GenZym turns consistency into a game. Users get a random routine of small, silly, low-effort tasks, finish them in one tap, and earn XP, coins, badges and streaks.
Coins buy profile frames and flex titles in the store, and a leaderboard keeps it social. Premium adds extra challenges, advanced tracking and exclusive themes.

highlights.title: 1-tap reps
highlights.text: Finish a micro-workout and bank the XP.

highlights.title: Cosmetic store
highlights.text: Spend coins on frames and flex titles.

highlights.text: Streaks, badges and social ranking.

highlights.title: Juicy feedback
highlights.text: Skia-rendered visuals, confetti and haptics.

projects.name: LinkPin – Personal Link Workspace
projects.tagline: Colour-coded topic shelves for your links, one-click pinning and instant Cmd+K search.
projects.summary: A New Tab link workspace with topic shelves, board and list views, usage-ranked links, and Cmd/Ctrl+K search. 100% local, with no account.
description: LinkPin turns scattered bookmarks and open tabs into an organised, searchable workspace on the New Tab page. Any tab can be pinned into a colour-coded topic in one click.
Everything is stored locally with chrome.storage: no account, no server and no tracking. Deleted links are archived and restorable, and backups export with one click.

highlights.text: Save the current tab straight into a topic.

highlights.title: Cmd/Ctrl+K search
highlights.text: Find any link in under a second.

highlights.title: Shelf, Board & List
highlights.text: Three views with drag-and-drop ordering.

highlights.title: 100% private
highlights.text: Local storage only, with export/import backups.

projects.name: Solidarity – Product Origin
projects.tagline: Scan any barcode to see its country of origin, judged by an open community vote.
projects.summary: A barcode scanner that resolves a product's GS1 country of registration and shows a transparent, crowd-sourced verdict for that country, with XP, streaks and leaderboards.
description: Solidarity lets shoppers know exactly what they're buying. They scan a product's barcode, or type it in, and see the country it's registered to in seconds.

Instead of a developer deciding which countries are good or bad, every country's status comes from open, real-time community voting that any verified member can update. Scanning and voting earn XP, streaks and badges.

highlights.title: Instant barcode scan
highlights.text: Camera scanning with GS1 prefix lookup.

highlights.title: Community voting
highlights.text: Transparent, live up/down votes per country.

highlights.title: Contribution graph
highlights.text: GitHub-style daily activity with full scan history.

highlights.title: XP & leaderboard
highlights.text: Levels, streaks, badges and an opt-in global ranking.

projects.name: Code Breakout
projects.tagline: A break enforcer that opens a retro Breakout or Pong game right inside VS Code.
projects.summary: A pomodoro-style VS Code extension that tracks real typing time and launches a themed mini-game in an editor tab when it's time to step away.
description: Code Breakout counts continuous coding time from real keystrokes and filters out programmatic edits like format-on-save, so they don't count as work. Idle time resets the counter.
When a break is due it opens a retro Breakout or Pong game in a Webview themed with the current VS Code colours. Hard Mode hides the skip button and pulls focus back until the break is over.

highlights.title: Smart activity tracking
highlights.text: Real keystrokes only, ignoring bulk and programmatic edits.

highlights.title: In-editor mini-games
highlights.text: Breakout or Pong in a theme-aware Webview.

highlights.title: Hard Mode
highlights.text: No skipping, and focus is pulled back to the break.

highlights.title: Status bar timer
highlights.text: Shows coding time and a live break countdown.

projects.name: SoundSleep
projects.tagline: Mix rain, wind, forest and ocean into the soundscape that sends you to sleep.
projects.summary: An offline-first sleep app with a 4-track ambient mixer, fade-out sleep timer, shake-to-extend and a gentle wake ramp.
description: SoundSleep layers looping nature sounds into a personal mix, then fades them out over five minutes when the sleep timer ends.

A shake adds 15 more minutes without unlocking the phone, and Gentle Wake ramps a storm track back in at alarm time, with a Notifee notification as a fallback. Settings persist instantly with MMKV and sync through Firebase.

highlights.title: 4-track mixer
highlights.text: Independent volume per ambient layer.

highlights.title: Fade-out timer
highlights.text: Linear five-minute fade when the timer ends.

highlights.title: Shake to extend
highlights.text: The accelerometer adds 15 minutes with no unlock needed.

highlights.title: Gentle wake
highlights.text: Volume ramps in, with a notification fallback.

projects.name: Ludo Pro
projects.tagline: Classic Ludo with Power Tiles, a fast Quick Match mode and smart bots.
projects.summary: A modern Ludo game with classic rules, Power Tiles that teleport, shield or grant extra rolls, a timer-based Quick Match, and Easy, Medium and Hard bot AI.
description: Ludo Pro keeps the rules everyone knows (roll a 6 to leave the yard, capture opponents, use safe squares, race home) and adds Power Tiles that teleport, shield or grant an extra roll.
Quick Match makes a shorter, timer-based game, and any seat can be a human or an Easy, Medium or Hard bot, all driven by a match-flow state machine.

highlights.text: Faithful Ludo with captures and safe squares.

highlights.title: Power Tiles
highlights.text: Teleport, shield and extra-roll squares.

highlights.title: 3-level bot AI
